card.name: Nutrient amounts in food and RDA lists
card.fires_on: The space or first digit just before a nutrient quantity (milligrams, micrograms, grams) in dietary tables and recommended-intake text. Seen in food-source lists and RDA values by age.

modes.label: RDA by age
modes.description: The space or first digit before a recommended daily amount for a child age group.
modes.example: for children 9-13 years-old the RDA is <<3>>00

modes.label: Food content tables
modes.description: The gap or decimal point before a nutrient value in a food table row.

modes.label: Amounts in food advice
modes.description: The space before an amount of a nutrient or fiber gained from foods.
modes.example: you’ll add about<< >>4 more grams of fiber.

card.writes: It pushes toward nutrition words such as nutrient, vitamin and nutritional, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires just before a number giving how much of a vitamin, mineral or fiber is in a food or recommended daily.
